en.body:
🇨🇭 How can Switzerland speed up the deployment of solar photovoltaic and wind energy?

Join us on 9 September for the next SWEET EDGE webinar, dedicated to the public policies and levers that can accelerate Switzerland's energy transition.

Bringing together experts from research, public authorities, utilities, and cantons, this webinar will explore the key challenges and levers for accelerating the deployment of solar PV and wind energy in Switzerland. The discussion with [Isabelle Stadelmann-Steffen](https://www.linkedin.com/in/isabelle-stadelmann-steffen-5835b5282/), [Laurent Mineau](https://www.linkedin.com/in/laurent-mineau/), [Mohamed Malik Meghari](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mohamed-malik-meghari-8675ab4/) and [Véronique Bittner-Priez](https://www.linkedin.com/in/v%C3%A9ronique-bittner-priez-9571724b/) will be followed by a live Q&A session with the audience.

### Event details

📅 9 September 2026

🕦 11:30 AM – 12:45 PM (CEST)

💻 Online

**👉 [Register now](https://forms.cloud.microsoft/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=w0Hf2gvvY0-ef0xXc7r4kXscF0bN0PpFheEYqzGgPHdUNVY0NEFVMVdOR1pZR0lVODhXNFBXWVdDSC4u&route=shorturl)**

We look forward to welcoming you online!

**Please note that the webinar will be held in French.**
